_note: Generated from DCAT-AP-UK. Names match the metadata weaver, so records written by the weaver load into these definitions. Not tested against a live tenant. Atlan addresses custom metadata by internal names in its API; map these names when loading.

businessMetadataDefs.name: dcat_ap_uk
businessMetadataDefs.description: DCAT-AP-UK properties that the Atlas base model does not have.

attributeDefs.name: title
attributeDefs.description: The name of the resource, in plain English.

attributeDefs.name: description
attributeDefs.description: A plain English account of what the resource contains and what it can be used for.

attributeDefs.name: identifier
attributeDefs.description: The main identifier of the resource in the publisher's own catalogue.

attributeDefs.name: publisher
attributeDefs.description: The organisation responsible for making the resource available.

attributeDefs.name: contactPoint
attributeDefs.description: Where to ask questions about the resource or give feedback on it.

attributeDefs.name: accessRights
attributeDefs.description: Who can get the data, and on what terms.

attributeDefs.name: securityClassification
attributeDefs.description: The classification under the Government Security Classifications Policy that the data itself carries.

attributeDefs.name: licence
attributeDefs.description: The licence under which the resource can be used.

attributeDefs.name: accrualPeriodicity
attributeDefs.description: How often the resource is updated.

attributeDefs.name: criticalDataAsset
attributeDefs.description: Whether the resource is a critical data asset under the Data Asset Management Policy.

attributeDefs.name: creator
attributeDefs.description: The organisation that created or compiled the content of the resource.

attributeDefs.name: created
attributeDefs.description: The date the content of the resource was created or compiled.

attributeDefs.name: conformsTo
attributeDefs.description: A standard, specification or schema the resource follows.

attributeDefs.name: temporal
attributeDefs.description: The period of time the data is about.

attributeDefs.name: personalData
attributeDefs.description: Whether the data contains information about identifiable living people, and in what form.

attributeDefs.name: rights
attributeDefs.description: A statement of any restriction on access or use, such as the data sharing agreement or legal gateway needed.

attributeDefs.name: modified
attributeDefs.description: The date the content of the resource last changed.

attributeDefs.name: issued
attributeDefs.description: The date the resource was first made available.

attributeDefs.name: abstract
attributeDefs.description: A one-sentence summary of the resource, of no more than 250 characters.

attributeDefs.name: theme
attributeDefs.description: The broad subject of the resource, from a controlled list.

attributeDefs.name: keyword
attributeDefs.description: Words or short phrases that people might search for, not already in the title or description.

attributeDefs.name: spatial
attributeDefs.description: The geographic area the data is about.

attributeDefs.name: distribution
attributeDefs.description: A form in which the data can be got, such as a file or an API.

attributeDefs.name: landingPage
attributeDefs.description: A web page where people can find out about the resource and how to get it.

attributeDefs.name: version
attributeDefs.description: The version of the resource.

attributeDefs.name: sensitiveData
attributeDefs.description: Whether the data contains information that needs extra care beyond being personal, such as special category data.

attributeDefs.name: qualifiedAttribution
attributeDefs.description: An organisation and the role it plays for the resource, such as data owner or data steward.

attributeDefs.name: language
attributeDefs.description: The language or languages of the resource.

attributeDefs.name: alternative
attributeDefs.description: Another name the resource is known by, such as an abbreviation or a former name.

attributeDefs.name: otherIdentifier
attributeDefs.description: Any other identifier the resource is known by, such as one in a national or sector register.

attributeDefs.name: inSeries
attributeDefs.description: The dataset series this dataset belongs to.

attributeDefs.name: isReplacedBy
attributeDefs.description: A newer resource that replaces this one.

attributeDefs.name: expires
attributeDefs.description: The date after which the resource should no longer be used.

attributeDefs.name: previousVersion
attributeDefs.description: The version this one replaces in a sequence.

attributeDefs.name: versionNotes
attributeDefs.description: What changed in this version.

attributeDefs.name: spatialResolutionInMeters
attributeDefs.description: The smallest distance the data can tell apart, in metres.

attributeDefs.name: temporalResolution
attributeDefs.description: The smallest period the data can tell apart, as an ISO 8601 duration.

attributeDefs.name: referenceData
attributeDefs.description: A code list, classification or set of groupings the data uses, such as age bands or a geography.

attributeDefs.name: qualityAnnotation
attributeDefs.description: A link to a published statement or measurement of the quality of the data.

attributeDefs.name: relation
attributeDefs.description: Another resource closely related to this one, such as the report the data supports.

attributeDefs.name: qualifiedRelation
attributeDefs.description: A related resource together with the kind of relationship.

attributeDefs.name: documentation
attributeDefs.description: A web page that documents the resource, such as a user guide or a methodology.

attributeDefs.name: metadataAudience
attributeDefs.description: Who is allowed to see the metadata record itself.

attributeDefs.name: applicableLegislation
attributeDefs.description: Legislation that requires, governs or permits the publication or sharing of the resource.

attributeDefs.name: hasPolicy
attributeDefs.description: A machine-readable policy, in the W3C Open Digital Rights Language (ODRL), saying what may and may not be done with the resource.

attributeDefs.name: jurisdiction
attributeDefs.displayName: Where the data is held or sent
attributeDefs.description: Every country or territory where the data is stored or processed, or to which it is sent.

attributeDefs.name: transferMechanism
attributeDefs.description: The basis under UK GDPR on which personal data in the resource may be sent outside the UK.

attributeDefs.name: missingValue
attributeDefs.description: A property this record leaves empty on purpose, and why.
